correctness.rationale: A local bijection at off-cycle vertices gives degree factor b(d). The exact cycle-vertex choices depend on equality of the two adjacent cycle colors and yield weights t,1,2. Proper three-color cyclic increments ±1 have zero mod-three total; zero weights force all increments constant on arcs between attachment vertices. The modular signed-gap zero equation has a solution exactly unless one gap is nondivisible by three. A constructive four-coloring handles m=5 with attachments and every other m via 3-and-4 blocks. The independently implemented checker corroborates the precise enumerator on 276 sampled graphs and all 504 leaf-subset cycle patterns.
